Meta.title: Playground — try Previously on a real memory
Meta.description: A live, read-only demo of Previously running on a real two-and-a-half-year memory dataset: episodic recall, card evolution, and slice anatomy — no signup, no API key.

Intro.title: Try it on a real memory
Intro.body: This is Previously running live on a real dataset: one person's two-and-a-half-year memory, 97 conversation slices from January 2024 to August 2026. Pick a preset below — the demo asks the question for you, and the agent answers from actual memory, not a script.
Intro.rules: Demo rules: presets only, no free-form input. Everything runs read-only — the evolution demo computes what would change, but nothing is written; refresh and it's as if it never happened.
Intro.anatomyHeading: Anatomy — how a slice gets remembered

recall-worldcup.label: World Cup final night
recall-worldcup.question: What was I doing around the 2026 World Cup final? Who was I with?

recall-mom.label: Mom's health scare
recall-mom.question: What happened with my mom's health in 2025? When did I find out?

recall-marathon.label: The half-marathon finish
recall-marathon.question: Tell me about the day I finished my first half-marathon.

evolution-card.label: Watch the card evolve
evolution-card.question: Run one card-evolution pass over my latest slices — what would change, and why?

slice-anatomy.label: How a slice gets remembered
slice-anatomy.question: Explain how this slice gets remembered — where does each part of it come from?
